reasoning_summary: Selected features prioritize stable, interpretable credit risk signals with low missingness and broad coverage across key semantic groups: credit score, indebtedness, repayment behavior, delinquency, utilization, income capacity, and customer demographics. Features with high missingness or unstable sparse tail distributions were excluded. Redundancy was controlled by preferring representative aggregates and avoiding near-duplicate variables unless they add distinct information. Categorical bands and flags are included to support stable, interpretable modeling and scorecard defense. Features related to missingness flags or with zero variance were excluded.
